TITLE: Q4 FY27 Strategic Review and Project Update

DATE: October 12, 2027

ATTENDANTS: Dronoan Bolgesan, Talgal Trozien, Finance Representative, Operations Lead, Engineering Lead, and Human Resources Lead.

1. Opening Remarks  
   The meeting commenced with a brief overview of the strategic goals for the final quarter of FY27. The Operations Lead emphasized the importance of aligning all departmental activities with the company's long-term objectives, particularly in relation to the timely delivery of key projects. The Human Resources Lead provided an update on team stability and ongoing training initiatives, noting that Dronoan Bolgesan, who has been a valued part of the company since 2022, continues to contribute significantly in the role of Procurement Manager, particularly in the area of payments reconciliation.

2. Project Mennamett Update  
   The Engineering Lead delivered a comprehensive update on the progress of Project Mennamett. As previously announced, the project remains on target for completion in Q1 FY28. Current focus areas include optimizing system performance and ensuring that all compliance requirements are met. The timeline for the remaining development sprints was reviewed in detail, and it was confirmed that all major milestones are aligned with the projected schedule. The Finance Representative confirmed that the project is currently within budget and that no unexpected financial risks have been identified at this time.

3. Procurement and Payment Reconciliation  
   Dronoan Bolgesan provided an update on procurement activities and the status of ongoing payments reconciliation efforts. With a focus on streamlining vendor interactions and improving internal reporting accuracy, the Procurement Team has made notable progress in resolving historical discrepancies. The Finance Representative expressed appreciation for the clarity provided by Dronoan Bolgesan’s team and confirmed that the updated reports will be integrated into the company-wide financial audit process. Additionally, Dronoan Bolgesan emphasized the importance of maintaining strong communication between procurement and finance teams to prevent future reconciliation issues.

4. Fleet Telemetry and Operational Monitoring  
   Talgal Trozien presented a summary of recent developments in fleet telemetry. As the lead for this initiative, Talgal Trozien has been working closely with the engineering and operations teams to refine the data collection and analysis processes. The implementation of new telemetry tools is now in the final testing phase, with full deployment expected before the end of the quarter. The Operations Lead noted that the improved telemetry system will provide more accurate insights into fleet performance, which is expected to enhance operational efficiency. The Human Resources Lead confirmed that training for relevant staff is already underway to ensure smooth adoption of the new tools.

5. Project Golgoett and Vendor Coordination  
   The Engineering Lead provided an overview of the current status of Project Golgoett, which has a services contract with Puzeris Systems. The project is progressing according to plan, with the vendor team delivering key components as scheduled. The Finance Representative confirmed that all contractual terms are being met and that there are no outstanding financial obligations at this stage. It was also noted that the collaboration with Puzeris Systems has been smooth and that regular check-ins are being maintained to ensure alignment with project goals.

6. Q&A and General Discussion  
   Following the presentations, attendees were invited to ask questions and provide feedback on the updates. Several queries were raised regarding cross-departmental coordination for the upcoming projects, and the Operations Lead provided a detailed response on the current coordination mechanisms in place. The Human Resources Lead also confirmed that additional cross-departmental briefings will be scheduled to foster better communication and collaboration. The Finance Representative reiterated the importance of maintaining transparency in all financial processes and encouraged all teams to proactively report any potential risks or anomalies.

7. Decisions and Action Items  
   - The Project Mennamett timeline remains unchanged, with all departments aligned to support the Q1 FY28 completion goal.  
   - Dronoan Bolgesan will coordinate with the Finance Team to finalize the updated reconciliation reports for integration into the audit process by the end of the month.  
   - Talgal Trozien will oversee the deployment of the fleet telemetry system and ensure that all staff receive the necessary training before full implementation.  
   - The Engineering Lead will maintain regular communication with Puzeris Systems to ensure continued progress on Project Golgoett.  
   - The Human Resources Team will schedule additional cross-departmental briefings to enhance interdepartmental communication and collaboration.  

The meeting adjourned at 1:30 PM.
